title: Beatrix and the Ghost
author: Theo Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Crane, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
